messages:
alex_support: Customer escalation — intermittently getting 400 from /v1/embeddings: "dimension mismatch: expected 1024 got 1536". Started after SDK v2.4.1 rollout. Two paying customers, production impact. Repro steps + logs below.

maria_sre: Any recent infra deploys or autoscale events around the spikes? :thinking:

alertbot: [03:05:12 UTC] high-error-rate alert on embeddings-route (support-prod) — 400s from batcher x3 in 10m

jason_eng: We had a canary of SDK v2.4.1 rolled to ~20% yesterday (embed client change: added `prefer_variant: auto` header). I rolled that canary forward but paused when telemetry looked noisy.

ingrid_ml: Note: last week we onboarded `text-embed-adept-xl` as a capacity-backed variant. Its output dim is 1536 (standard variant is 1024). Routing should only fallback to XL if explicitly allowed, but the SDK header may have loosened constraints.

alex_support: Repro (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-adept-002","input":["test"], "client_meta": {"sdk_version": "2.4.1"}}'
```
Server log snippet (prod):
```
2026-03-16T03:11:53Z batcher: coalesced 12 reqs (models: [adept-002, adept-002, xl, adept-002, adept-002, xl])
2026-03-16T03:11:53Z runtime: preparing kvcache shards
2026-03-16T03:11:54Z runtime: error replying to call: 400 "dimension mismatch: expected 1024 got 1536"
```

maria_sre: That log looks like the batcher coalesced requests across model variants. We should never mix different output dims in the same batch.

jason_eng: Confirmed — dynamic batching merges requests by arrival window only (coalesce_window_ms = 8) and currently relies on the routing layer upstream to provide model compatibility. If routing allowed an `auto` variant hint, the batcher would see different underlying kernels and different dims.

ingrid_ml: Immediate mitigation options:
- Force routing to honor explicit `model` field and ignore `prefer_variant` from SDK for production routes.
- Hotfix batcher to validate `output_dim` before packing requests and split if mismatch.

alex_support: Customer workaround applied: pinned request to `text-embed-adept-002:standard` via support API proxy for affected customers — errors stopped for them. They reported tail latency improved but throughput slightly lower.

jason_eng: Short-term hotfix deployed (03:28 UTC): batcher now performs a cheap `expected_dim` check during coalesce and will split mixed-dim groups. Deploy-bot: `deploy embed-batcher hotfix v2026.3.16-0300` succeeded.

\deploy-bot: Deployment completed: embed-batcher v2026.3.16-0300 -> ok

alertbot: Post-hotfix metrics: 95th latency dropped from 1.2s -> 240ms, 99th from 1.8s -> 360ms, error rate back to baseline.

ingrid_ml: Root cause timeline: SDK v2.4.1 started sending `prefer_variant: auto` header for embeddings. Routing occasionally resolved to XL when standard pool was saturated; batcher merged requests within coalesce window so mixed dims created 400s. Two independent failures: (1) routing allowed variant fallback without honoring client expectation, (2) batcher lacked final compatibility check.

jason_eng: Follow-ups (owners):
- jason_eng: make batcher reject/segregate mixed-dim requests (PR in flight, code owner runtime/batcher).
- ingrid_ml: add test coverage for variant fallback + embedding dim checks in model onboarding tests.
- maria_sre: alert rule tuning — fire earlier on mixed-dim coalescing and autoscale throttles.
- alex_support: update KB for support workarounds (pin variant, how to inspect logs).

alex_support: Billing note: customers asked whether they were charged for failed requests — billing-bot flagged ~120 failed tokens; support offered credit for affected window.

alertbot: Billing review ticket created: #INC-2026-78

jason_eng: Longer term: consider making batcher aware of model_variant as an explicit coalesce key (split sharding so different variants can't be merged). Also add schema to routing decisions so `output_dim` is part of the request envelope.

alex_support: Customer follow-up: they accepted workaround when we pinned variant and confirmed stable for 24h. Marking as mitigated but not resolved until PR lands.

maria_sre: Thanks team. Assigning to jason_eng + ingrid_ml for next 48h. If no PR by then, we schedule an emergency patch. :thumbsup:
